title: How Far Can a Trainable Frequency Move? Resolution, Grids and Coupling in Trainable-FrequencyQuantum Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.23409v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trainable-frequency quantum models train the prefactors of their encoding gates so that the circuit's frequencies can move onto the target's. From the unit start of prior work, training rarely reaches a target more than one resolution step away. We show that the target-driven part of the prefactor gradient is a weighted sum of slopes of the overlap $\sin u/u$, where $u$ is the model-target frequency distance scaled by the window half-width. This gives each frequency a reach: under gradient flow, an isolated real frequency whose coefficient adapts optimally reaches its target from within half a step, for every target at least one step from zero frequency; with a fixed coefficient, a phase-dependent barrier can stop it. A ternary prefactor grid places a model frequency within half a step of every band frequency, with logarithmically many encoding gates. translated_title: 可训练频率能移动多远？可训练频率量子模型中的分辨率、网格与耦合
translated_abstract: 可训练频率量子模型通过训练其编码门的前置因子，使电路的频率能够移动到目标的频率上。从先前工作的单位起始点出发，训练很少能到达距离超过一个分辨率步长的目标。我们证明，前置因子梯度中由目标驱动的部分是重叠函数 sin u/u 斜率的加权和，其中 u 是按窗口半宽缩放的模型-目标频率距离。这赋予每个频率一个“可达范围”：在梯度流下，一个系数最优自适应的孤立实频率能够从半个步长之内到达其目标，只要目标距离零频率至少一个步长；而在系数固定的情况下，一个依赖相位的势垒可能会阻止它。一个三值前置因子网格能够使模型频率与每个频带频率的差距都在半个步长以内，且只需对数数量的编码门。使用 Adam 训练的单频率电路以及联合训练的振幅……
tldr: 该论文揭示了可训练频率量子模型中前置因子梯度的解析结构——由 sin u/u 重叠函数斜率的加权和决定每个频率的可达范围，并提出三值前置因子网格方案，仅用对数数量的编码门即可将模型频率逼近所有频带频率至半个步长以内。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the target-driven part of the prefactor gradient in trainable-frequency quantum models is a weighted sum of slopes of the sin u/u overlap function, which bounds each frequency's reach, and proposes a ternary prefactor grid that places model frequencies within half a step of every band frequency using only logarithmically many encoding gates.
